reason: Independent reviewers identified that candidate-level absolute P-O error is not the relevant deployment-time scale for a ranking decision and that the paper's model-matched population must remain primary. The definitive analysis therefore uses a prediction-only within-menu score and stricter held-out gates. No physical-outcome result informed these changes.

definitive_population.primary: 562 rows forming 281 complete JEPA-WM/DINO-WM cells across 20 trajectory clusters

primary_predictor.name: prediction_only_near_tie_score
primary_predictor.definition: After collapsing exact duplicate physical actions, let m=P_(2)-P_(1), let IQR(P)=Q_0.75(P)-Q_0.25(P), and set U=-log10(max(m/max(IQR(P),1e-12),1e-12)). Larger U means more ambiguity.
primary_predictor.deployment_constraint: U uses predicted candidate scores and action hashes only; O, G, J, recovery status, and current-row prediction errors are forbidden features.

primary_target: P and O select different actions

validation.outer_split: leave one complete trajectory_id out, including both models, all offsets, and all seeds
validation.fixed_flag: highest-U quarter using the same-model 75th-percentile cutoff computed from the other trajectories
validation.probability_model: fixed-ridge logistic regression with intercept, model indicator, and standardized U; all parameters fitted on other trajectories
baselines: model indicator plus raw log margin
validation.uncertainty: 10000 whole-trajectory bootstrap resamples; loss comparisons use paired trajectory-average differences

robustness: action-bounded S=max(abs(action))<=3 menus with winners recomputed after filtering

claim_gates.selector_instability: OOF AUROC >=0.70 with trajectory-bootstrap lower bound >0.60; flagged-quarter switch-risk ratio >=1.5 with lower bound >1; model-specific AUROCs both >0.65; bounded-support and original-only directions agree; probability model improves Brier or log loss over the model-only baseline.
claim_gates.physical_risk: Both G and J show higher harm in the flagged quarter and lower selective harm after abstention, with at least one whole-trajectory interval excluding no improvement. Otherwise no physical-risk, safety, or general uncertainty claim.

terminology: Even on passage, call U a prediction-score near-tie indicator or held-out selector-instability predictor, not epistemic/aleatoric uncertainty.
